slides.text: Ghar pe padhai nahi ho paati? Yeh 5 cheezein try karo
Padhne ki jagah fix karo. Bed par nahi, table par. Dimaag jagah se mood pakadta hai.
Phone doosre kamre mein rakho. Silent par bhi table par rakha phone dhyan khichta hai.
25 minute padho, 5 minute break lo. Break mein scroll mat karo. Paani piyo ya khadke ho jao.
Din ka sabse mushkil subject pehle lo, jab dimaag fresh ho.
Padhne se pehle likho: aaj kaunsa topic khatam karna hai. Bina target ke ghanton ka kuch nahi.
Har hafte ek din fix karo jisme sirf revision ho.
Save karo. Kal se ek cheez aazma ke dekho.
slides.sub: Follow for one study rule a day

caption:
Ghar pe padhai mushkil lagti hai? Bahut baar problem discipline ki nahi, environment ki hoti hai.

Tumhara sabse bada distraction kya hai? Comment karo.
